experiment_data.hypothesis: N=20 AR eval stabilizes Llama 3-way (Base/TG/LoRA-only) autoregressive GAR estimates. N=5 suffered from outlier influence (3/5 conv had GAR>0.4 outlier turns); N=20 provides robust mean±std.

spec.command: bash -c "source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base && cd /root/turn_residual_gating && bash scripts/eval_llama_ar_n20.sh"

experiment_data.notes: N=20 AR eval stabilizes 3-way Llama comparison. Key finding: GAR-ours ranking reverses vs N=5 — TG(0.0434) > LO(0.0284) > Base(0.0088), confirming gate provides genuine GAR benefit beyond LoRA alone. N=5 had LoRA-only inflated to 0.0617 by outlier turns. GAR-dongre ranking: LO(0.0205) > TG(0.0183) > Base(0.0049) — dongre metric shows smaller effect sizes, LO slightly edges TG. PPL ordering preserved: Base(1.29) < LO(1.42) < TG(1.44). Outlier turns still present in N=20 (TG conv9/15/18 have GAR>0.4 single turns, LO conv10/12/18/20 similar) but diluted by 4x larger sample. T=4 vs N=5's T=10 means fewer turn observations per conv, but 4x more conversations compensates.
